CORRECTION (operator-directed) of the 2026-05-31T21:30 blocked diagnosis. The prior 'infra/DB reviewer-completion hang for ALL reviewers' conclusion was WRONG -- it was a MEASUREMENT ARTIFACT plus a stuck-session interaction, not an outage. Two root errors in the prior reading: (1) status was being polled via a tRPC path 'reviewSession.list' that DOES NOT EXIST (the real read endpoints are reviewSession.getDocumentHistory / reviewSession.get) -- every such probe 404'd ('No procedure found on path reviewSession.list', visible in Railway Deploy Logs as dozens of identical red lines, all self-inflicted, NOT reviewer failures); and (2) an earlier flaky-reviewer failure had left a session stuck state=active, so each new create hit SESSION_ALREADY_EXISTS (409) -- which looked like 'hanging' but was 'blocked by a leftover active session'. INFRA CONFIRMED HEALTHY this session: TiDB Cloud dashboard Active, RU/storage ~0, billed $0.12/$50, query duration ~5-20ms; Railway Network Flow Logs show healthy DB egress (75.2.85.188:4000 / 99.83.147.192:4000, all OK, ~8ms); Railway upgraded to Pro; clean container start at 20:54 EDT; Deploy Logs show NO timeout/fetch-failed/ENOTFOUND/provider errors. POSITIVE EVIDENCE the reviewer path works: a single-reviewer GPT Lite run RETURNED feedback (1 suggestion); GPT Lite returned in EVERY run it was in. THE ACTUAL BLOCKER is multi-reviewer reliability + a stuck-session bug: (a) Gemini Lite returned INVALID JSON for structured output ('SyntaxError: Expected , or } ... position 1284') and failed its session; (b) on a clean GPT Lite + Claude Lite retry (iter11, driven by Claude), GPT Lite committed 1 suggestion but Claude Lite never returned within >12min, leaving the session state=active, evaluation=NULL; (c) when any one reviewer fails/never-returns, the WHOLE multi-reviewer session fails AND is left stuck 'active' (no failed-state transition), which is also what produces the SESSION_ALREADY_EXISTS that blocks the next attempt. NET: the MR-CAL-5C evaluator is NOT implicated and is NOT YET live-verified -- across all attempts we never got two reviewers to both succeed in one session, so the evaluator never fired (evaluation=NULL throughout). 5D-LIVE remains BLOCKED, but on reviewer reliability + the stuck-active-session bug, NOT on infra. New synthetic sessions accrued (iter 9-11 active/abandoned) -> LLN-PROD-CLEANUP-1. Evidence: live reviewer feedback + reviewSession.getDocumentHistory/get reads via Chrome (UNIVERSALTITLE) on doc cbf83ad7-a437-4aa7-9ecb-7a31d7985a95; Railway Deploy Logs + Network Flow Logs + TiDB dashboard screenshots (operator-supplied).

recommended_followups.why: Live MR-CAL-5D-LIVE attempt: gemini-2.5-flash failed with 'response is not valid JSON for structured output: SyntaxError: Expected , or } ... position 1284', failing the whole session. Same JSON-contract brittleness class that MR-IR-GEN-2 fixed for information-request generation (structuredOutputSchema + tolerant parse), still affecting the Gemini reviewer adapter. Until addressed, avoid Gemini for multi-reviewer/evaluator runs; prefer GPT/GPT Lite/Claude.
